verdict.rationale: QuickBooks docs explicitly describe A/R aging reports ('run the A/R aging report to see which customers are late with their payments') and per-customer tracking of invoices, payments, and delinquent accounts, plus statement reminders for late-paying customers. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the aging report's accuracy or depth, and no sample screenshot/detail on per-customer balance breakdown beyond marketing copy.
